stories.title: AIG Women's Open Round 1 — Korda, Ryu, and Ko Tee Off Together at Royal Lytham

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
AIG Women's Open Round 1 is underway at Royal Lytham.

Korda and Ryu — who've split all four 2026 women's majors — are grouped with Lydia Ko.

One more major win for either ties Inbee Park's record of three in a single calendar year. #AIGWO #GolfFanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The marquee group at Royal Lytham (8:42 AM):

Nelly Korda — Chevron + US Women's Open champion
Haeran Ryu — KPMG + Evian champion
Lydia Ko — 2024 AIG champion

$10M purse. Final women's major of 2026. #AIGWO #GolfFanrecap

stories.title: The Final Rocket Classic Begins — On a Completely Renovated Detroit Golf Club

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
The last Rocket Classic starts today — on a different course.

Detroit Golf Club's $16.1M restoration: par 70 (was 72), 300 yards added, Donald Ross 1914 bunkering restored.

Cameron Young is the favorite. Scheffler and McIlroy are resting. #RocketClassic #GolfFanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
What changed at Detroit Golf Club for 2026:

• Par 70 (was 72)
• 300 yards added to scorecard
• Holes 7 & 17 converted to 505- and 537-yard par 4s
• 91 bunkers (was 84)
• Donald Ross' original 1914 design restored

Same address. Different course. #RocketClassic #GolfFanrecap

stories.title: LIV Golf After Michigan — Two Events Left, CEO Can't Guarantee Either Will Happen

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf's 2026 season: 14 events planned. New Orleans canceled. Michigan canceled.

Two events remain — Bedminster (Aug 6-9) and Indianapolis (Aug 20-23).

When asked if he could guarantee those happen, CEO Scott O'Neil said he couldn't. #LIVGolf #GolfFanrecap

stories.title: Scheffler Is Sitting Out the Rocket Classic — Still No. 1 Despite Winless Six Months

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler isn't at the Rocket Classic this week.

Last win: The American Express in January. Since then: five runner-ups, four major near-misses. Still World No. 1. Still FedExCup No. 1.

He's resting before the playoffs. #FedExCup #PGATour #GolfFanrecap
